title: Kairo IDE Source Audit & Refactoring Implementation Backlog

findings.title: Java 6 compilation target silently elevated by compiler
File URI passed directly to compile interface without host path normalization
HotSwap defaults to first debuggable server
Await compilation reads mutable current session risking cross-target replacement
Matching artifact by first matching class basename cannot identify inner classes
Multiple ClassLoaders for same class name defaults to refs[0]
DAP errors treated as unavailable triggering blind JDWP fallback causing port contention
JDWP char/short encoded as 4 bytes instead of 2 bytes
JDWP handshake uses single Read assuming no packet fragmentation
Direct JDWP path lacks event demuxing and IDSizes negotiation
Packet length and cursor boundary unchecked before memory allocation
JDWP error code table contains erroneous mappings (e.g. 10 as VM_DEAD)
Streaming search consumer exit does not cancel producers
UTF-16 raw bytes used for EOL detection causing CRLF to be misdetected as LF
Charset detection overly broad, unknown encodings defaulted to UTF-8
JSP single-block virtual Java lacks full page semantic context
Concurrent JSP completions share virtual URI causing open/close conflicts
Agent restart lacks port and readiness handoff protocol
Custom build timeout cancel discarded causing timer leak
Idempotency cache only keys on requestId without status or payload fingerprint
String prefix startsWith check is not a directory containment check
Documentation and codebase drifted, deprecated compatibility APIs easily misused
HotSwap stop lifecycle does not own subscriptions and in-flight operations
Agent address configurable and secret dispatch lacks explicit whitelist binding
